title: 6.6.21 Fix the Broken Chart: the Pause State
description: Someone half-wired a pause feature and the chart shows it. Find what the red checks are pointing at and repair it.

diagram.starter:
flowchart TD
  A([draw() runs]) --> B{state == "play"}
  B -- yes --> C[[updateGame()]]
  C --> D{p pressed}
  D -- yes --> E[state = "paused"]
  D -- no --> F([end of frame])
  E --> E
  G[[drawPauseScreen()]]
